## Claims

- For Indicator 11 (serious bleeding in newly diagnosed patients), Denmark overall showed 691 / 21,804 patients (3.2%, 95% CI 2.9-3.4) developing serious bleeding in the period 01.07.2022 - 30.06.2023 [^src1] ([[indikator-11-serious-bleeding-newly-diagnosed]], [[danmark|Danmark]])
